apiProbe.responseSemantics: The backend returned a bounded deterministic answer after the model path timed out. It is a real backend response but not a verified evidence-backed conclusion.

trustRules: All target percentages, evidence counts, timestamps, chat messages, source names, player identities, avatar identities and tab labels are placeholders and never runtime facts.
The target defines the seven-region composition, three suggested-question rows, three evidence-card positions, three composer action positions and four-column Product TabBar topology.
The initial route has no conversation-history endpoint. It renders one deterministic boundary message and must not fabricate the target's two user messages or two assistant answers.

A sent user message is local pending state until the backend returns. The assistant content, session id, source, confidence, limitations, missing inputs, next question and evidence references come only from chickenbro.messages.

A deterministic_fallback answer returned by the backend is usable bounded guidance but remains low confidence and must expose its source or limitation. A transport fallback is blocked and offers retry without a local fake answer.
The target's 2/10 and 20% evidence progress are forbidden. The context panel may show the real evidenceRefs count and missing-input state without inventing a capacity or percentage.
The two evidence source cards map only to returned evidenceRefs. Missing references retain the two card positions as blocked placeholders; no battle log, timeline, SimC, WCL or profile is invented.
Upload evidence and paste-link actions retain their target positions but remain disabled until an owned ingestion contract exists. Their presence cannot imply an uploaded source.
The canonical product navigation remains 资讯, 专精, 队长, 我的 with 队长 selected on this route. The target's first-tab 智能分析 selection is a visual placeholder and cannot replace the registered route contract.
AppShell, PageFrame and the shared ProductTabBar remain the only safe-area, header-capsule and bottom-navigation owners.

mappings.runtime: AppShell tab-root surface and PageFrame simulator-home variant

real carried context, real evidence reference and missing-input state, plus three app-authored safe prompt actions
one deterministic initial boundary message followed only by locally sent and backend-returned messages
two returned evidence reference positions or blocked placeholders plus one unavailable ingestion position
editable draft, disabled unsupported upload and link actions, real send and retry state

stateContract.idle: mount all seven regions, three prompt rows, a stable transcript viewport, three evidence positions, three composer actions and four product tabs
stateContract.submitting: retain all geometry, append the real pending user message, disable duplicate send and show a bounded loading state
stateContract.ready: append the backend assistant message and expose answer source, confidence, limitations, missing inputs and evidence references when present
stateContract.partial: retain the backend deterministic answer while clearly labeling low confidence, missing inputs or absent evidence
stateContract.blocked: retain all regions, show the transport boundary, keep the last submitted message and expose retry
stateContract.error: retain all regions and allow deterministic retry without synthesizing an answer
stateContract.empty: use only the deterministic initial boundary message; do not synthesize target conversation history
